description: Whatever is moved in a respect is in potency in that respect, from the conclusion of NO-MOVED-WITHOUT-POTENCY-FROM-ANALYSIS (the Ash'arite rival fails on the same MovedIn and InPotency) and excluded middle. The refutation's premise (STMT-BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY) stays OPEN; the route premise is not established.
